Michael McFaul is the Peter and Helen Bing Senior Fellow at the Hoover Institution, Senior Fellow at the Freedman Spogli Institute for International Studies, and a professor of political science at Stanford University, where he has taught since 1995. His expertise centers on Russian politics, democratization, international relations, and American foreign policy.
